fusions.name: Mote Chase
fusions.desc: Flicks a mote of arcana that deals 5 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Spell Impetus] for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Wild Spill
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 14 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawn to the Glow
fusions.desc: Restores 20 mana to you in one go.

fusions.name: Residual Spark
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
